messages.author: User
messages.text:
Fusionar 1.2 y 1.3
Where the M1ND lives
Segunda oración:
"Relay is optimized to run in cloud storage services for free syncing of your preferences"
Directory - que la default sea la de Cosmic (App data creo, fijarse donde escribe: Pathfinder.cs en Vigilum). Se puede cambiar la dirección. como ahí está el Change.
En vez de los dos botones New mind y Existing mind, si detecta una mind instalada, mostrar un banner con un checkbox que diga "Migrate legacy M1ND".

messages.author: overmind-hivem1nd
messages.text: Done. 1.2 Where the M1ND lives joins the folder and the sync in one step, so setup has 4 steps. The second sentence is the one given. The folder defaults to the Cosmic root with Change; the board shows AppData\Local\Cosmic\.m1nd until the common Cosmic root is settled with the Overseer (Vigilum's Pathfinder writes to Unity's persistentDataPath\Cosmic, the Cosmic apps use %LOCALAPPDATA%\Cosmic). New mind and Existing mind are gone: when a 2.x M1ND is found, a banner with the Migrate legacy M1ND checkbox appears.

messages.text:
La parte de Sync pedí que se sacara.
No entiendo porqué haríamos una diferenciación en eso, tipo... el directorio que el user elija ya está bien ycontemplado, no hay que avisar nada de eso.
Puede ser, sí, que haya otro banner como el de migrate que diga Use Relay+ (ahora en coming soon) que explique igual que puede usar el mismo servicio de Nebula+ para syncear sus preferencias en cualquier dispositivo. Como un aviso que a futuro ofreceremos ese servicio. Lo tenemos que hablar con el Overseer porque me gustaría que sea super barato... pero bueno no sé cómo hacer. Veremos. Quizá si abrimos github contribuitors y nos donan tienen perk y sino bueno pueden pagarlo en la página de Cosmic.

messages.author: overmind-hivem1nd
messages.text: Done. 1.2 has no sync choice: the folder chosen is the sync, since a folder inside a cloud storage service syncs through it. A second banner announces Use Relay+, coming soon: the same service as Nebula+ for preferences on any device. Ready (1.4) and Settings (6.1) no longer show a sync origin; Settings shows Relay+ as coming soon. The pricing idea went to the Overseer.

messages.author: User
messages.text: Ofrecer conectar los editors que se puedan tipo Claude app, Codex, Cursor, como hacemos nosotros ahora. Pero enfocarse principalmente en el CLI. Es el más accesible la verdad. Pensalo por acá y dame tus opiniones

messages.author: User
messages.text: Digo porque Cursor tuvo problemas, se puede hacer un CLI tipo chat y que se abra y descarten? También tener el flow que tenemos ahora manual de escribir en la app pero que enfoque a la orquestación eficiente de agentes via CLI que es lo más eficiente. Considerar cuestiones de permisos. pedir cambios y ofrecer hacerlos automático si se admite.

messages.author: overmind-hivem1nd
messages.text: Done as chosen in chat. 6.2 shows each agent with its CLI first (it runs the units, Auto or On demand) and the app connection as optional. 6.3 lists every configuration change before it is made, with Apply or Copy changes. 2.13 Start a session runs an Executor as one task that closes by default, or as a chat that can open other CLIs itself. Builders are gone from the sample.

messages.author: User
messages.text: Considerar potenciales fricciones, errores. Audit with Sonnet 5.5 (yours, not Cursor's).

messages.author: overmind-hivem1nd
messages.text: Done. A Sonnet 5.5 audit found 21 points. The consistency errors are fixed (aliases, counts, waiting badges, the offline LAPTOP, labels). With the owner's yes the board now also covers: agent permissions (6.3 review of every write, git apart and unticked, 6.5 Permissions with Revoke), the phone (no standing approvals on it, 7.3 lock, access open in 6.1), migration and a second machine (1.3 join, 1.4 close 2.x), deletions with confirmation and Undo (2.10, 2.18, 5.3, 6.7), failures (1.6, 1.9, 5.5, Stop in 3.3, 3.4 approval to open a CLI, Not confirmed in 3.6), the machine selector (6.4), projects in the library (4.3, 4.5), History (4.14) and accessibility (shapes for status, 32 px targets, muted text contrast). 83 screens.

messages.author: User
messages.text: No entiendo esto. Connect app es CLI?

messages.author: overmind-hivem1nd
messages.text: No: they are two different connections, and 6.2 now says so. The left column is the command line (CLI), how HIVEM1ND runs the units, a session per task. The right column is the desktop app (Claude app, Codex app, Cursor editor), optional, for writing to an agent in its own window; its button names the app.
